purpose: Teach: カルシウム/材質/耕作/司教/旧約/起立/見識/人身

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、骨粗鬆症のカルシウム代謝研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on calcium metabolism in osteoporosis research, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observational tone with a slight upward lift at the end—confirming what she already knows. Gentle and inviting, not testing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、人工歯の材質研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, actually I focused on material science research for artificial teeth.
lines.style: Quiet, straightforward delivery. A slight pause before the explanation, as if he's decided to be honest. Steady eye contact level, no rush.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、近世の耕作地分布研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, and you explored early modern land distribution patterns in your research, I recall.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly tentative phrasing—leaving room for him to correct her. Warm curiosity underneath. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、カトリック教会の司教職研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—my paper was actually on the development of episcopal authority in the Catholic Church.
lines.style: Direct but not defensive. A small beat before he clarifies. Polite firmness, like he's gently steering back to what matters to him.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 旧約聖書の文献研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you examined Old Testament textual traditions and literary analysis.
lines.style: Observant, slightly amused—catching the pattern. Warm tone, almost knowing. A light pause, like she's setting up.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、児童の起立性調節障害を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, my research focused on orthostatic dysregulation in children—how their bodies manage sudden position changes.
lines.style: Clearer this time, a touch more confident. He's answering directly but still soft. Not correcting her harshly, just stating his actual work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、専門家の見識形成の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, I imagine your work on how expertise and insight form in specialists was quite involved.
lines.style: Reflective, genuinely curious now. Slower pace. The tone of someone recognizing a pattern and wanting to understand it. Warm, not accusatory.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、人身売買防止策の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No—I actually researched human trafficking prevention strategies and intervention frameworks.
lines.style: Clear, purposeful. He's stopped hesitating. Final delivery with quiet conviction. This matters. Still kind, but not apologetic.
